Resolves #21337

The `fieldWithPrefix` example now reads as "Input masks": the portal record and the stage title carry the name, the page opens in the default theme like the other field entries (the `themes` override that put dark first is gone), the label reads "MAC Address", the phone mask is `+1 (___) ___-____` so it takes exactly a 10-digit US number, and a stage line says what to type. No public API changes.

Evidence: L3 (local file server + Playwright frames at both sizes and both themes, typing into the phone mask) -> L3 required (AC-2, AC-4, AC-5 are visual and behavioral).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` `field-with-prefix` name is "Input masks"; `componentName: 'Input masks'` sets the stage title (frames below) |
| AC-2 | Typing `ab4915113245678` into the phone field gives `+1 (491) 511-3245`: letters and the 11th digit onward are refused (frame [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]) |
| AC-3 | Label reads "[A-H] MAC Address" (frames below) |
| AC-4 | Opens in `neo-theme-light` like `examples/form/field/text`; also checked in `neo-theme-dark` (frames below) |
| AC-5 | Frames at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, before and after, below |

## Deltas from ticket
- `.neo-workbench-stage-desc` gets `white-space: normal` so the new one-line hint wraps instead of being cut off on a phone. No other example sets a stage description today, so nothing else changes.
- Out of scope, noted here: at 390 × 844 the 350 px example container still runs past the stage edge (same before and after), and the MAC field's `accept: '[A-H]'` does not match hex digits. Happy to file either as a follow-up.
